description: Apache Doris database provider for Entity Framework Core.
releaseNotes:
First stable release, for Entity Framework Core 10 on .NET 10.

JSON documents
- Complex types mapped with ComplexProperty(...).ToJson() are supported. The provider answers the
  JSON store type EF Core asks for and translates document access into Doris functions:
  json_extract_string for text members, CAST(json_extract_string(...) AS store type) for every
  other member, and json_extract for nested documents. OwnsOne(...).ToJson() stays unsupported.

Query translation
- Fixed string concatenation. Adding two strings was emitted as the + operator, which Doris
  evaluates as arithmetic and parses the operands as numbers; it now becomes CONCAT(...).

Migrations
- AddColumn, DropColumn, AlterColumn, RenameColumn, RenameTable, CreateIndex, DropIndex,
  EnsureSchema and DropSchema generate Doris DDL instead of throwing NotSupportedException.
- CREATE TABLE is deliberately emitted without IF NOT EXISTS, because Doris accepts that clause
  even when the existing table has a different shape, which would silently record a migration as
  applied against a table the model never matched.
- The migrations history repository now treats only a missing database as "no history table yet";
  connection and authentication failures surface instead of being reported as an empty history.
- ALTER TABLE ... COMMENT, and generated columns added by ALTER TABLE, are rejected with an
  explanation.

Model validation
- Complex properties are accepted when they are mapped to JSON; the rejection message for any other
  complex property now says how to fix it.

Known limitations
- No reverse engineering: dotnet ef dbcontext scaffold reports that the provider has no
  IDatabaseModelFactory.
- Navigations, owned types and ARRAY / MAP / STRUCT columns are not supported.
- DateTimeOffset has no native mapping and falls back to VARCHAR(48), so comparisons on it are
  lexicographic rather than by instant.

Packaging
- Targets net10.0 and depends on Microsoft.EntityFrameworkCore.Relational 10.0.x and
  MySqlConnector 2.6.1.
